title: Chapter 33: Pedestrian Merchant
content:
Chapter 33: Pedestrian Merchant

Finally, there are 5 treasure chests.

Wang Shuo suddenly became excited and opened the blind box.

He took out 5 bronze keys from the warehouse and opened 5 bronze boxes one by one.

The first box only had 500 units of feathers, which made Wang Shuo a little excited. In this way, he could make a lot of arrows.

The next four boxes had a total of 200 gold coins, 1000 (g) salt, 600 iron ore, and a telescope.

[Telescope: can increase vision. ]

Wang Shuo took the telescope in his hand and found that his vision did not change.

There was no fog in his territory, so it was almost full vision.

He closed one eye and looked through the telescope with the other eye, and the effect was immediate.

Wang Shuo could see trees farther away, and the clarity was as if they were right in front of him.

As for how far he could see, Wang Shuo could not test it for the time being.

Because his territory is currently only 500 meters in radius, within this range, it can be seen clearly with the naked eye, and there is no need for this telescope, but Wang Shuo believes that this thing will definitely be of great use in the future.

Wang Shuo is still very satisfied with this prop.

On the morning of the eleventh day, the sky looked extremely gloomy, and the heavy leaden clouds made people breathless.

Seeing this strange phenomenon, Wang Shuo looked solemn, and he hesitated whether to summon the traveling merchants now.

Wang Shuo also planned to put aside the energy tower that he originally planned to build for a while.

No matter what, Wang Shuo directly used the Flowing Clouds to gather the traveling merchants to summon the scroll.

I saw a flash of golden light in front of me, and a man riding a camel slowly walked out of the dazzling light.

The man was slender, his face was slightly red, and he was wearing a headscarf on his head. His exposed eyes were a little sky blue.

There were still some traces of wind and sand on his heavy robe.

The camel behind him was unusually huge, with a small attic the size of a millstone built directly between the two humps.

"Hello, Lord. I am Hadro, a peddler from Liuyunji." Hadro bowed to Wang Shuo, saluted, and smiled, "I feel your call, and I come to serve you."

"Hello, Mr. Hadro! Welcome." Wang Shuo took a few steps forward and wanted to go up and shake hands with the other party, but he suddenly stopped.

In this strange world, it is better to keep a certain distance from strangers.

"I don't know what you need to buy when you summon the peddler?" Hadro said, and on a piece of open space, he muttered something in his mouth, and with one hand, the small attic on the hump flew to the open space and turned into a two-story building.

The magical scene in front of him stunned Wang Shuo.

Hadro took the initiative to explain: "This is the foundation of our business, a shop that can change size. Only with it can we have the qualifications of a business."

"Lord, please!"

Hadro entered the shop first.

Wang Shuo hesitated for a moment, but followed him in.

Entering the shop, he found a different world.

From the outside, it looks like a small house of only 10 square meters, but the hall inside can accommodate forty or fifty people without being crowded at all.

In the hall, there are many shelves, and most of the goods on the shelves are packed in boxes. You can't see the real objects inside, only a name on the box.

"Lord, what do you need? I have weapons, blueprints, scrolls, and everything here. If you have supplies to sell, I will buy them."

Hearing the other party calling him Lord, Wang Shuo was very happy. He followed Hadro to the counter.

"It's the first time I do business with you. Can you take me to visit your shop?" Wang Shuo looked at the goods here, and he didn't recognize eight out of ten.

"Excuse me, dear guest, I am rude!" Hadro apologized quickly. It turned out that the lord in front of him was still a rookie.

So Hadro took Wang Shuo and walked between the shelves, carefully introducing his goods.

Wang Shuo was also very satisfied. Hadro's attitude was surprisingly good.

An hour later, Wang Shuo had a basic understanding of the situation here.

It turned out that Hadro was a member of the newly established Li Chamber of Commerce in Liuyunji. Due to his outstanding business ability, he was promoted to a peddler, which is equivalent to a business promoter, or a peddler walking around the streets.

This is much better than being a clerk in a store. This is a profession that many refugees dream of, but this profession is also very dangerous.

Wandering between various forces, buying and selling, you will also encounter various wild beasts and extreme weather, and even encounter robbers.

Each peddler will have an identity sensor card. Within a certain range, as long as someone nearby uses the peddler summoning scroll, they can choose whether to accept the summoning.

Just now, Hadro was still in a desert area, worrying about his customers.

Feeling someone calling him, Hadro agreed to the request directly.

Usually this situation means that it is time for them to make a fortune. Unless it is an emergency, they will not choose to summon peddlers.

One is the future lord and the other is a newly promoted peddler. The two chatted very happily.

"Lord, I didn't expect that you are qualified to summon peddlers while you are still in the novice trial stage. I admire you!"

"As far as I know, most players have to wait until they build a village before they have the chance to summon me."

"It was also by chance that I got such a scroll."

Hadro took out a list, which was called a list, but it was actually a thick book.

Wang Shuo took the book and opened it.

It was full of various commodities, including resources, buildings, pets...

The items above made Wang Shuo's eyes open and his heart was moved.

[Breadfruit tree seeds: You can plant a breadfruit tree, which will provide 100 units of bread in 2 days. ]

[Sweet potato seeds: You can grow 100 units of sweet potatoes in 2 days. ]

[Bronze long sword: Excellent level weapon, attack power +20, durability 30/30, common standard weapon in the army. ]

[Hundred-step piercing bow: Excellent level weapon, attack power +10, agility +8, durability 30/30, common standard weapon in the army. 】

The advantage of standard weapons is that the materials are common, easy to mass produce, and relatively easy to repair.

[Brute Force: Cultivation method, a total of nine levels, each level provides strength +2, constitution +1. 】

[Panlong Step: Cultivation method, a total of seven levels, each level provides agility +2, using Panlong Step, can instantly increase your own agility +10, lasting for 10 minutes. 】

Wang Shuo was dazzled by the dazzling array of items.

Wang Shuo roughly browsed and did not look closely.

There were seeds of various crops, various ores, as well as barracks, war horses, catapults, crossbows, skill books...

Wang Shuo was breathing rapidly after seeing this. Wang Shuo wanted all these things, but each one was very valuable. He was really poor.

Wang Shuo calmed down. Through these supplies, Wang Shuo also roughly knew that the future would definitely be an era of war.
